name: Zombie Tag
summary: Zombie Tag is a fast-paced online multiplayer tag game set in a construction-site parkour arena. Each round, one player starts as the zombie while the humans get a 10-second head start to run, climb and find escape routes. Every human the zombie catches is infected and joins the horde, so the chase gets more intense as the round goes on. Push other players with boxing gloves, stun them with bear traps and use the whole arena to survive until the timer runs out, or hunt down the last survivors as the zombie.
